text.en: 'Advice' or 'advise'? Questions like this test lexis (words) and structure (grammar). They carry many marks in WAEC, NECO and JAMB English, and a few simple habits can win them.
text.pcm: 'Advice' or 'advise'? Questions like this dey test lexis (words) and structure (grammar). Dem carry plenty marks for WAEC, NECO and JAMB English, and small simple habits fit help you win them.
text.yo: 'Advice' ni tàbí 'advise'? Irú àwọn ìbéèrè yìí ń dán lexis (ọ̀rọ̀) àti structure (gírámà) wò. Wọ́n ní máàkì púpọ̀ nínú Gẹ̀ẹ́sì WAEC, NECO àti JAMB, àṣà díẹ̀ tó rọrùn sì lè mú kí o rí wọn gbà.
text.ig: 'Advice' ka ọ bụ 'advise'? Ajụjụ ndị dị otú a na-anwale lexis (okwu) na structure (ụtọasụsụ). Ha nwere ọtụtụ akara n'ule Bekee nke WAEC, NECO na JAMB, omume ole na ole dị mfe nwekwara ike inyere gị aka inweta ha.
text.ha: 'Advice' ko 'advise'? Irin waɗannan tambayoyi suna gwada lexis (kalmomi) da structure (nahawu). Suna da maki masu yawa a Turancin WAEC, NECO da JAMB, kuma wasu ɗabi'u masu sauƙi za su taimaka maka ka same su.
text.fr: 'Advice' ou 'advise' ? Ces questions testent le lexique (lexis) et la grammaire (structure). Elles rapportent beaucoup de points en anglais au WAEC, au NECO et au JAMB, et quelques réflexes simples permettent de les gagner.
text.ar: 'Advice' أم 'advise'؟ تختبر هذه الأسئلة المفردات (lexis) والقواعد (structure). ولها درجات كثيرة في امتحانات اللغة الإنجليزية WAEC وNECO وJAMB، ويمكن لعادات بسيطة قليلة أن تكسبك إياها.
text.sw: 'Advice' au 'advise'? Maswali kama haya hupima msamiati (lexis) na sarufi (structure). Yana alama nyingi katika Kiingereza cha WAEC, NECO na JAMB, na tabia chache rahisi zinaweza kukusaidia kuzipata.
text.pt: 'Advice' ou 'advise'? Perguntas assim testam o léxico (lexis) e a gramática (structure). Valem muitos pontos no inglês do WAEC, NECO e JAMB, e alguns hábitos simples ajudam a ganhá-los.
text.es: ¿'Advice' o 'advise'? Preguntas así evalúan el léxico (lexis) y la gramática (structure). Valen muchos puntos en el inglés de WAEC, NECO y JAMB, y unos hábitos sencillos ayudan a conseguirlos.

text.en: Habit 1: read the whole sentence before you look at the options. The words after the gap often change the answer, so never choose from the first few words alone.
text.pcm: Habit 1: read the whole sentence before you look the options. The words wey dey after the gap fit change the answer, so no ever choose from only the first few words.
text.yo: Àṣà 1: ka gbogbo gbólóhùn kí o tó wo àwọn àṣàyàn. Àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ tó wà lẹ́yìn àlàfo sábà máa ń yí ìdáhùn padà, nítorí náà má ṣe yan ìdáhùn láti inú ọ̀rọ̀ díẹ̀ àkọ́kọ́ nìkan.
text.ig: Omume 1: gụchaa ahịrịokwu ahụ dum tupu ị lee nhọrọ ndị ahụ. Okwu ndị dị n'azụ oghere ahụ na-agbanwekarị azịza ya, ya mere ahọrọla naanị site n'okwu ole na ole mbụ.
text.ha: Ɗabi'a ta 1: ka karanta jimlar duka kafin ka duba zaɓuɓɓukan. Kalmomin da ke bayan gurbin sukan canja amsar, don haka kada ka zaɓa daga kalmomin farko kaɗai.
text.fr: Réflexe 1 : lisez toute la phrase avant de regarder les options. Les mots placés après le blanc changent souvent la réponse : ne choisissez donc jamais d'après les premiers mots seulement.
text.ar: العادة 1: اقرأ الجملة كاملة قبل أن تنظر إلى الخيارات. فالكلمات التي تأتي بعد الفراغ كثيرًا ما تغيّر الإجابة، فلا تختر أبدًا اعتمادًا على الكلمات الأولى وحدها.
text.sw: Tabia ya 1: soma sentensi nzima kabla ya kuangalia machaguo. Maneno yaliyo baada ya pengo mara nyingi hubadilisha jibu, kwa hiyo usichague kamwe kwa kutumia maneno machache ya mwanzo pekee.
text.pt: Hábito 1: lê a frase inteira antes de olhares para as opções. As palavras depois do espaço mudam muitas vezes a resposta, por isso nunca escolhas só a partir das primeiras palavras.
text.es: Hábito 1: lee la oración completa antes de mirar las opciones. Las palabras que siguen al hueco a menudo cambian la respuesta, así que nunca elijas solo por las primeras palabras.

text.en: Habit 2: look for tense clues. 'Yesterday' calls for the past: 'She arrived yesterday.' 'Since' usually calls for the perfect: 'I have lived here since 2020.'
text.pcm: Habit 2: look for tense clues. 'Yesterday' dey call for past tense: 'She arrived yesterday.' 'Since' dey usually call for the perfect tense: 'I have lived here since 2020.'
text.yo: Àṣà 2: wá àmì tó ń fi tense (àsìkò ìṣe) hàn. 'Yesterday' ń béèrè past tense: 'She arrived yesterday.' 'Since' sábà máa ń béèrè perfect tense: 'I have lived here since 2020.'
text.ig: Omume 2: chọọ ihe na-egosi tense (oge ngwaa). 'Yesterday' na-achọ past tense: 'She arrived yesterday.' 'Since' na-achọkarị perfect tense: 'I have lived here since 2020.'
text.ha: Ɗabi'a ta 2: nemi alamun tense (lokacin aikatau). 'Yesterday' tana buƙatar past tense: 'She arrived yesterday.' 'Since' yawanci tana buƙatar perfect tense: 'I have lived here since 2020.'
text.fr: Réflexe 2 : cherchez les indices de temps (tense). 'Yesterday' appelle le passé (past) : 'She arrived yesterday.' 'Since' appelle en général le parfait (perfect) : 'I have lived here since 2020.'
text.ar: العادة 2: ابحث عن دلائل الزمن (tense). كلمة 'Yesterday' تتطلب الماضي (past): 'She arrived yesterday.' وكلمة 'Since' تتطلب عادةً التام (perfect): 'I have lived here since 2020.'
text.sw: Tabia ya 2: tafuta dalili za njeo (tense). 'Yesterday' huhitaji wakati uliopita (past): 'She arrived yesterday.' 'Since' kwa kawaida huhitaji hali timilifu (perfect): 'I have lived here since 2020.'
text.pt: Hábito 2: procura pistas de tempo verbal (tense). 'Yesterday' pede o passado (past): 'She arrived yesterday.' 'Since' pede geralmente o perfeito (perfect): 'I have lived here since 2020.'
text.es: Hábito 2: busca pistas del tiempo verbal (tense). 'Yesterday' pide el pasado (past): 'She arrived yesterday.' 'Since' suele pedir el perfecto (perfect): 'I have lived here since 2020.'

text.en: Habit 3: cross out the options you know are wrong. If you can remove two of the four, your chance of choosing correctly rises from 1 in 4 to 1 in 2.
text.pcm: Habit 3: cross out the options wey you sabi say dem wrong. If you fit remove two out of the four, your chance to choose correct go rise from 1 in 4 to 1 in 2.
text.yo: Àṣà 3: fa ìlà sí àwọn àṣàyàn tí o mọ̀ pé wọ́n jẹ́ àṣìṣe. Bí o bá lè yọ méjì kúrò nínú mẹ́rin, àǹfààní rẹ láti yan èyí tó tọ́ á gòkè láti 1 nínú 4 sí 1 nínú 2.
text.ig: Omume 3: gbachapụ nhọrọ ndị ị maara na ha ezighị ezi. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere ike iwepụ abụọ n'ime anọ, ohere gị ịhọrọ nke ziri ezi ga-arị site na 1 n'ime 4 ruo 1 n'ime 2.
text.ha: Ɗabi'a ta 3: ka goge zaɓuɓɓukan da ka san ba daidai ba ne. Idan za ka iya cire biyu daga cikin huɗu, damarka ta zaɓar daidai za ta hau daga 1 cikin 4 zuwa 1 cikin 2.
text.fr: Réflexe 3 : barrez les options que vous savez fausses. Si vous pouvez en éliminer deux sur quatre, votre chance de bien répondre passe de 1 sur 4 à 1 sur 2.
text.ar: العادة 3: اشطب الخيارات التي تعرف أنها خاطئة. فإذا استطعت حذف خيارين من الأربعة، ارتفعت فرصتك في الاختيار الصحيح من 1 من 4 إلى 1 من 2.
text.sw: Tabia ya 3: futa machaguo unayojua kuwa si sahihi. Ukiweza kuondoa mawili kati ya manne, nafasi yako ya kuchagua sahihi hupanda kutoka 1 kati ya 4 hadi 1 kati ya 2.
text.pt: Hábito 3: risca as opções que sabes estarem erradas. Se conseguires eliminar duas das quatro, a tua probabilidade de acertar sobe de 1 em 4 para 1 em 2.
text.es: Hábito 3: tacha las opciones que sabes que son incorrectas. Si puedes eliminar dos de las cuatro, tu probabilidad de acertar sube de 1 entre 4 a 1 entre 2.

text.en: Synonyms have nearly the same meaning, like 'big' and 'large'. Antonyms have opposite meanings, like 'generous' and 'stingy'. Check carefully which one the question asks for.
text.pcm: Synonyms get almost the same meaning, like 'big' and 'large'. Antonyms get opposite meaning, like 'generous' and 'stingy'. Check well which one the question dey ask for.
text.yo: Synonyms (ọ̀rọ̀ onítumọ̀ kan náà) ní ìtumọ̀ tó fẹ́rẹ̀ẹ́ jọra, bí 'big' àti 'large'. Antonyms (ọ̀rọ̀ òdìkejì) ní ìtumọ̀ òdìkejì, bí 'generous' àti 'stingy'. Ṣàyẹ̀wò dáadáa èyí tí ìbéèrè ń béèrè.
text.ig: Synonyms (okwu yiri ibe ha) nwere ihe fọrọ nke nta ka ọ bụrụ otu nkọwa, dị ka 'big' na 'large'. Antonyms (okwu megidere ibe ha) nwere nkọwa dị iche kpamkpam, dị ka 'generous' na 'stingy'. Lezie anya nke ajụjụ na-achọ.
text.ha: Synonyms (kalmomi masu ma'ana ɗaya) suna da kusan ma'ana iri ɗaya, kamar 'big' da 'large'. Antonyms (kishiyoyi) suna da ma'ana saɓani, kamar 'generous' da 'stingy'. Ka duba da kyau wanda tambayar ke nema.
text.fr: Les synonymes (synonyms) ont presque le même sens, comme 'big' et 'large'. Les antonymes (antonyms) ont des sens opposés, comme 'generous' et 'stingy'. Vérifiez bien ce que demande la question.
text.ar: المترادفات (synonyms) لها المعنى نفسه تقريبًا، مثل 'big' و'large'. والأضداد (antonyms) لها معانٍ متعاكسة، مثل 'generous' و'stingy'. تحقق جيدًا مما يطلبه السؤال.
text.sw: Visawe (synonyms) vina karibu maana moja, kama 'big' na 'large'. Vinyume (antonyms) vina maana zinazopingana, kama 'generous' na 'stingy'. Angalia kwa makini swali linaomba kipi.
text.pt: Os sinónimos (synonyms) têm quase o mesmo significado, como 'big' e 'large'. Os antónimos (antonyms) têm significados opostos, como 'generous' e 'stingy'. Verifica bem o que a pergunta pede.
text.es: Los sinónimos (synonyms) significan casi lo mismo, como 'big' y 'large'. Los antónimos (antonyms) tienen significados opuestos, como 'generous' y 'stingy'. Comprueba bien qué pide la pregunta.

text.es: Ejemplo resuelto: 'The judge was impartial.' Significado más cercano: A angry, B fair, C biased, D tired. 'Impartial' significa no tomar partido, así que la respuesta es B, 'fair'.

text.en: Concord means agreement. A singular subject takes a singular verb and a plural subject takes a plural verb: 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' First find the true subject.
text.pcm: Concord mean agreement. Singular subject dey take singular verb and plural subject dey take plural verb: 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' First find the true subject.
text.yo: Concord túmọ̀ sí ìbámu. Olùwà ẹyọ (singular subject) ń gba ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe ẹyọ, olùwà ọ̀pọ̀ (plural subject) sì ń gba ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe ọ̀pọ̀: 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' Kọ́kọ́ wá olùwà tòótọ́.
text.ig: Concord pụtara nkwekọ. Isiokwu otu (singular subject) na-ewe ngwaa otu, isiokwu ọtụtụ (plural subject) na-ewe ngwaa ọtụtụ: 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' Buru ụzọ chọta ezigbo isiokwu ahụ.
text.ha: Concord na nufin daidaituwa. Mai aiki ɗaya (singular subject) yana ɗaukar aikatau na ɗaya, mai aiki jam'i (plural subject) kuma yana ɗaukar aikatau na jam'i: 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' Da farko ka nemo ainihin mai aikin.
text.fr: La concordance (concord) est l'accord. Un sujet singulier prend un verbe au singulier et un sujet pluriel un verbe au pluriel : 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' Trouvez d'abord le vrai sujet.
text.ar: التوافق (concord) يعني المطابقة. فالفاعل المفرد يأخذ فعلًا مفردًا والفاعل الجمع يأخذ فعلًا جمعًا: 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' ابحث أولًا عن الفاعل الحقيقي.
text.sw: Upatanisho (concord) maana yake ni mapatano. Kiima cha umoja huchukua kitenzi cha umoja na kiima cha wingi huchukua kitenzi cha wingi: 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' Kwanza tafuta kiima halisi.
text.pt: A concordância (concord) é o acordo. Um sujeito no singular leva o verbo no singular e um sujeito no plural leva o verbo no plural: 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' Encontra primeiro o verdadeiro sujeito.
text.es: La concordancia (concord) es el acuerdo. Un sujeto singular lleva un verbo singular y un sujeto plural lleva un verbo plural: 'The boy runs.' 'The boys run.' Primero encuentra el verdadero sujeto.

text.en: Worked example: 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' Ignore 'of pencils': the subject is 'box', which is singular. So the verb is 'is': 'The box of pencils is on the table.'
text.pcm: Worked example: 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' Ignore 'of pencils': the subject na 'box', wey be singular. So the verb na 'is': 'The box of pencils is on the table.'
text.yo: Àpẹẹrẹ tí a ṣe: 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' Má ṣe ka 'of pencils' kún: olùwà ni 'box', ẹyọ sì ni. Nítorí náà ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe ni 'is': 'The box of pencils is on the table.'
text.ig: Ọmụmaatụ a rụrụ: 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' Hapụ 'of pencils': isiokwu ahụ bụ 'box', nke bụ otu. Ya mere ngwaa ahụ bụ 'is': 'The box of pencils is on the table.'
text.ha: Misalin da aka warware: 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' Ka yi watsi da 'of pencils': mai aikin shi ne 'box', kuma ɗaya ne. Don haka aikatau shi ne 'is': 'The box of pencils is on the table.'
text.fr: Exemple résolu : 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' Ignorez 'of pencils' : le sujet est 'box', au singulier. Le verbe est donc 'is' : 'The box of pencils is on the table.'
text.ar: مثال محلول: 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' تجاهل 'of pencils': فالفاعل هو 'box' وهو مفرد. إذن الفعل هو 'is': 'The box of pencils is on the table.'
text.sw: Mfano uliotatuliwa: 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' Puuza 'of pencils': kiima ni 'box', ambacho ni cha umoja. Kwa hiyo kitenzi ni 'is': 'The box of pencils is on the table.'
text.pt: Exemplo resolvido: 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' Ignora 'of pencils': o sujeito é 'box', no singular. Logo, o verbo é 'is': 'The box of pencils is on the table.'
text.es: Ejemplo resuelto: 'The box of pencils ___ on the table.' Ignora 'of pencils': el sujeto es 'box', en singular. Por tanto, el verbo es 'is': 'The box of pencils is on the table.'

text.en: 'Each' and 'everyone' take a singular verb: 'Each of the students has a book.' With 'neither ... nor', the verb agrees with the nearer subject: 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'
text.pcm: 'Each' and 'everyone' dey take singular verb: 'Each of the students has a book.' With 'neither ... nor', the verb dey agree with the subject wey near am: 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'
text.yo: 'Each' àti 'everyone' ń gba ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe ẹyọ: 'Each of the students has a book.' Pẹ̀lú 'neither ... nor', ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe ń bá olùwà tó sún mọ́ ọn jù mu: 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'
text.ig: 'Each' na 'everyone' na-ewe ngwaa otu: 'Each of the students has a book.' Na 'neither ... nor', ngwaa na-ekwekọ n'isiokwu kacha ya nso: 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'
text.ha: 'Each' da 'everyone' suna ɗaukar aikatau na ɗaya: 'Each of the students has a book.' Da 'neither ... nor', aikatau yana daidaita da mai aikin da ya fi kusa da shi: 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'
text.fr: 'Each' et 'everyone' prennent un verbe au singulier : 'Each of the students has a book.' Avec 'neither ... nor', le verbe s'accorde avec le sujet le plus proche : 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'
text.ar: تأخذ 'Each' و'everyone' فعلًا مفردًا: 'Each of the students has a book.' ومع 'neither ... nor' يطابق الفعل الفاعل الأقرب إليه: 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'
text.sw: 'Each' na 'everyone' huchukua kitenzi cha umoja: 'Each of the students has a book.' Kwa 'neither ... nor', kitenzi hupatana na kiima kilicho karibu nacho: 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'
text.pt: 'Each' e 'everyone' levam o verbo no singular: 'Each of the students has a book.' Com 'neither ... nor', o verbo concorda com o sujeito mais próximo: 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'
text.es: 'Each' y 'everyone' llevan verbo en singular: 'Each of the students has a book.' Con 'neither ... nor', el verbo concuerda con el sujeto más cercano: 'Neither Ada nor her sisters were late.'

text.en: Confusables look alike but differ in use. 'Affect' is usually a verb and 'effect' is usually a noun: 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'
text.pcm: Confusables dey look alike but dem no get the same use. 'Affect' na usually verb and 'effect' na usually noun: 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'
text.yo: Confusables (ọ̀rọ̀ tó ń ṣini lọ́nà) jọra, ṣùgbọ́n ìlò wọn yàtọ̀. 'Affect' sábà máa ń jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-ìṣe (verb), 'effect' sì sábà máa ń jẹ́ ọ̀rọ̀-orúkọ (noun): 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'
text.ig: Confusables (okwu na-agbagwoju anya) yiri ibe ha mana ojiji ha dị iche. 'Affect' na-abụkarị ngwaa (verb), 'effect' na-abụkarị aha (noun): 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'
text.ha: Confusables (kalmomi masu rikitarwa) suna kama da juna amma amfaninsu ya bambanta. 'Affect' yawanci aikatau ne (verb), 'effect' kuma yawanci suna ne (noun): 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'
text.fr: Les mots confondus (confusables) se ressemblent mais s'emploient différemment. 'Affect' est le plus souvent un verbe et 'effect' un nom : 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'
text.ar: الكلمات المتشابهة (confusables) تتقارب في الشكل وتختلف في الاستعمال. فكلمة 'Affect' فعل في الغالب و'effect' اسم في الغالب: 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'
text.sw: Maneno yanayochanganya (confusables) hufanana lakini hutumiwa tofauti. 'Affect' kwa kawaida ni kitenzi na 'effect' kwa kawaida ni nomino: 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'
text.pt: As palavras confundíveis (confusables) parecem-se, mas usam-se de forma diferente. 'Affect' é geralmente um verbo e 'effect' geralmente um nome: 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'
text.es: Las palabras confusas (confusables) se parecen pero se usan de forma distinta. 'Affect' suele ser verbo y 'effect' suele ser sustantivo: 'Noise can affect your sleep.' 'Noise has a bad effect on your sleep.'

text.en: Some words always take a particular preposition: 'good at', 'interested in', 'depend on', 'different from'. Also remember that we 'discuss' something, never 'discuss about' it.
text.pcm: Some words dey always take one particular preposition: 'good at', 'interested in', 'depend on', 'different from'. Also remember say we 'discuss' something, never 'discuss about' am.
text.yo: Àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ kan máa ń gba preposition (atọ́ka ipò) pàtó nígbà gbogbo: 'good at', 'interested in', 'depend on', 'different from'. Rántí pẹ̀lú pé a máa ń 'discuss' nǹkan, kì í ṣe 'discuss about'.
text.ig: Okwu ụfọdụ na-ewe otu preposition (mbuụzọ) mgbe niile: 'good at', 'interested in', 'depend on', 'different from'. Chetakwa na anyị na-'discuss' ihe, ọ bụghị 'discuss about'.
text.ha: Wasu kalmomi kullum suna ɗaukar wata preposition (harafin dangantaka) ta musamman: 'good at', 'interested in', 'depend on', 'different from'. Ka kuma tuna muna 'discuss' abu, ba 'discuss about' ba.
text.fr: Certains mots prennent toujours une préposition (preposition) précise : 'good at', 'interested in', 'depend on', 'different from'. Retenez aussi qu'on dit 'discuss' quelque chose, jamais 'discuss about'.
text.ar: بعض الكلمات تأخذ دائمًا حرف جر (preposition) محددًا: 'good at' و'interested in' و'depend on' و'different from'. وتذكّر أيضًا أننا نقول 'discuss' مباشرة، ولا نقول أبدًا 'discuss about'.
text.sw: Maneno fulani huchukua kihusishi (preposition) maalum kila wakati: 'good at', 'interested in', 'depend on', 'different from'. Kumbuka pia kwamba tunasema 'discuss' kitu, kamwe si 'discuss about'.
text.pt: Certas palavras levam sempre uma preposição (preposition) específica: 'good at', 'interested in', 'depend on', 'different from'. Lembra-te também de que se diz 'discuss' algo, nunca 'discuss about'.
text.es: Algunas palabras siempre llevan una preposición (preposition) concreta: 'good at', 'interested in', 'depend on', 'different from'. Recuerda también que se dice 'discuss' algo, nunca 'discuss about'.

text.en: An idiom means more than its words say. Before exams you may 'burn the midnight oil', which means to study late into the night. 'A piece of cake' means something very easy.
text.pcm: Idiom mean pass wetin the words talk. Before exam you fit 'burn the midnight oil', wey mean to study reach late for night. 'A piece of cake' mean something wey easy well well.
text.yo: Idiom (àkànlò èdè) ní ìtumọ̀ ju ohun tí àwọn ọ̀rọ̀ inú rẹ̀ sọ lọ. Kí ìdánwò tó dé, o lè 'burn the midnight oil', èyí tó túmọ̀ sí kíkàwé títí di òru. 'A piece of cake' túmọ̀ sí ohun tó rọrùn gan-an.
text.ig: Idiom (akpaalaokwu) pụtara karịa ihe okwu ya kwuru. Tupu ule, ị nwere ike 'burn the midnight oil', nke pụtara ịgụ akwụkwọ ruo n'abalị. 'A piece of cake' pụtara ihe dị mfe nke ukwuu.
text.ha: Idiom (karin magana) yana da ma'ana fiye da abin da kalmominsa suka faɗa. Kafin jarrabawa za ka iya 'burn the midnight oil', wato yin karatu har cikin dare. 'A piece of cake' na nufin abu mai sauƙi sosai.
text.fr: Une expression idiomatique (idiom) veut dire plus que ses mots. Avant les examens, vous pouvez 'burn the midnight oil', c'est-à-dire étudier tard dans la nuit. 'A piece of cake' désigne une chose très facile.
text.ar: التعبير الاصطلاحي (idiom) يعني أكثر مما تقوله كلماته. فقبل الامتحانات قد تقوم بـ'burn the midnight oil'، أي تدرس حتى وقت متأخر من الليل. أما 'A piece of cake' فتعني شيئًا سهلًا جدًا.
text.sw: Nahau (idiom) ina maana zaidi ya maneno yake. Kabla ya mitihani unaweza 'burn the midnight oil', yaani kusoma hadi usiku sana. 'A piece of cake' maana yake ni kitu rahisi sana.
text.pt: Uma expressão idiomática (idiom) quer dizer mais do que as suas palavras. Antes dos exames podes 'burn the midnight oil', ou seja, estudar até tarde da noite. 'A piece of cake' significa algo muito fácil.
text.es: Una expresión idiomática (idiom) significa más de lo que dicen sus palabras. Antes de los exámenes puedes 'burn the midnight oil', es decir, estudiar hasta muy tarde. 'A piece of cake' significa algo muy fácil.

text.en: Worked example: 'Tunde let the cat out of the bag.' This means Tunde: A freed a pet, B revealed a secret, C lost a bag, D told a lie. The idiom means to reveal a secret, so B.
text.pcm: Worked example: 'Tunde let the cat out of the bag.' This one mean say Tunde: A freed a pet, B revealed a secret, C lost a bag, D told a lie. The idiom mean to reveal secret, so na B.

text.en: A question tag turns a statement into a question. A positive statement takes a negative tag, and a negative statement a positive tag: 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
text.pcm: Question tag dey turn statement to question. Positive statement dey take negative tag, and negative statement dey take positive tag: 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
text.yo: Question tag ń sọ gbólóhùn di ìbéèrè. Gbólóhùn ìdánilójú (positive) ń gba tag òdì (negative), gbólóhùn òdì sì ń gba tag ìdánilójú: 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
text.ig: Question tag na-eme ka nkwupụta ghọọ ajụjụ. Nkwupụta positive na-ewe tag negative, nkwupụta negative na-ewe tag positive: 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
text.ha: Question tag yana mayar da jimlar bayani tambaya. Jimla mai tabbatarwa (positive) tana ɗaukar tag na korewa (negative), jimlar korewa kuma tana ɗaukar tag na tabbatarwa: 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
text.fr: Une question-tag (question tag) transforme une affirmation en question. Une phrase positive prend un tag négatif, et une phrase négative un tag positif : 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
text.ar: السؤال الذيلي (question tag) يحوّل الخبر إلى سؤال. فالجملة المثبتة تأخذ ذيلًا منفيًا، والجملة المنفية تأخذ ذيلًا مثبتًا: 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
text.sw: Swali mkia (question tag) hugeuza kauli kuwa swali. Kauli chanya huchukua mkia hasi, na kauli hasi huchukua mkia chanya: 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
text.pt: Uma question tag transforma uma afirmação numa pergunta. Uma frase afirmativa leva uma tag negativa, e uma frase negativa leva uma tag afirmativa: 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
text.es: Una question tag convierte una afirmación en pregunta. Una frase afirmativa lleva una tag negativa, y una frase negativa lleva una tag afirmativa: 'You are tired, aren't you?' 'She doesn't sing, does she?'
